performance_observation.scope: Actual signed private Commit initially remained busy while other watched repositories restored; AX observation duration is not a controlled full-startup benchmark.
performance_observation.finding: All180 active-worker samples were FinderSnapshotStore.publish -> validate -> FileTransferPaths.lexicalPath; main thread idle. Startup configureActionRouting creates FinderWatchManager.restore for every saved root. Publication revalidates contributions and serializes them under a global file lock.
performance_observation.limit: No direct Commit.reload await on Finder publication or global Git serialization found. The sample establishes expensive competing Finder work, not the cause or resolution of complete Commit delay. LibGit2 runtime selection uses executable-file checks, without repeated signature/hash verification.
performance_observation.next_family: Isolate action-dialog watched-root startup and reduce duplicate path/contribution validation while retaining security, leases, corruption handling and cancellation; measure Commit phases separately at that family checkpoint.
